_doc: GARUDA FIR ingestion circuit (Phase 3). Catalyst Circuits orchestrate the serverless steps with retries and error handling. This file DOCUMENTS the intended orchestration; create/confirm the circuit in the console Circuit builder (exact field names/types may differ by Catalyst version). The single-function event handler in functions/ingest-event implements the same flow inline for the simple path — use this circuit when you want per-step retries, fan-out, or a dead-letter on OCR/extract failure.
name: fir_ingest
comment: Stratus FIR scan -> Zia OCR -> AppSail extract -> Review_Queue (human-in-the-loop)

OCR.comment: Zia OCR: download the scan from Stratus and convert to raw text

Extract.comment: AppSail brain: text -> structured fields + per-field confidence + review record

Queue.comment: Insert Review_Queue row (status=pending). Humans approve in the review UI; never auto-promote.

DeadLetter.comment: Record the failure for re-drive (Audit_Log); operator inspects and re-uploads.
